definition_zh: 独立的；自主的；不相关的
definition_en: not controlled by or relying on other people or things
core_image: 两根柱子之间没有横梁相连，各自立着
scene: 两个人可以意见不同，却依旧是朋友。She is independent enough to make her own decision.
sceneCN: 这里 independent 是「独立的」（第 1 个义项：自主做决定）；句意是她足够独立，能自己做决定。

pos.zh: 形容词：独立的；自主的；不相关的
名词：无党派人士（少见）

derivatives.zh: 义为「独立地」，由本词加 -ly 构成
义为「独立、自主」
义为「依赖的」，去掉 in- 即成相反形式
义为「依靠」，与本词同根

senses.title: Able to act or decide alone
senses.titleCN: 独立的：能自主行动或决定
senses.definition: able to do things or make decisions without help from others
senses.definitionCN: 能够不需他人帮助做事或做决定
senses.example: She is independent enough to make her own decision.
senses.exampleCN: 她足够独立，能自己做决定。
senses.why: The stem depend means to hang from; the prefix in- says the hanging has been cut.
senses.whyCN: 词干 depend 意为「悬挂于」，前缀 in- 表示那根挂绳已被剪断。

senses.title: Not ruled by another country
senses.titleCN: 国家独立：不受他国统治
senses.definition: governing itself rather than being ruled from outside
senses.definitionCN: 自行治理而不受外部统治
senses.example: The island became independent in nineteen eighty.
senses.exampleCN: 这座岛在一九八零年独立。
senses.why: Politics uses the same image at the scale of a whole territory.
senses.whyCN: 政治在整片领土的尺度上使用同一意象。

senses.title: Not connected or affected by
senses.titleCN: 不相关的：不受影响
senses.definition: not depending on something else for its value or truth
senses.definitionCN: 其价值或真实性不取决于其他事物
senses.example: The two results are independent of each other.
senses.exampleCN: 这两个结果彼此无关。
senses.why: In mathematics and science, no hang means no link: one quantity does not move the other.
senses.whyCN: 在数学与科学里，不「挂」就是无关联：一个量不会带动另一个量。

senses.title: Not belonging to a party or company
senses.titleCN: 独立的：不属于党派或机构
senses.definition: not controlled by a political party, a company or a large organization
senses.definitionCN: 不受政党、公司或大型机构控制
senses.example: The report was written by an independent expert.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告由一位独立专家撰写。
senses.why: Freedom from an owner is valued as impartiality, so the word turns into a guarantee.
senses.whyCN: 摆脱所有者被视为公正，于是这个词本身成了一种保证。

senses.title: As a noun, one who is unaffiliated
senses.titleCN: 名词：无党派人士
senses.definition: a person who does not belong to a political party
senses.definitionCN: 不属于任何政党的人
senses.example: Two independents hold the balance in the council.
senses.exampleCN: 两名无党派人士在议会中掌握关键票数。
senses.why: A shorthand grew from the adjective: no party label, so simply an independent.
senses.whyCN: 从形容词缩出一个名词：没有党籍标签，就叫 independent。

intro.en: Independent joins in-, not, to dependent, from Latin dependere, to hang from.
intro.cn: independent 把否定前缀 in- 加到 dependent 之上，后者源自拉丁语 dependere「悬挂于」。

items.en: Pendere meant to hang, and dependere meant to hang down from something.
items.cn: pendere 意为「悬挂」，dependere 意为「从某物上垂挂」。

items.en: Ecclesiastical writers formed independentia for freedom from another's rule.
items.cn: 教会作家造出 independentia，表示不依附于他人统治。

items.en: The adjective entered English in the seventeenth century.
items.cn: 这个形容词在十七世纪进入英语。

items.en: Political and scientific uses made it a general word for no dependence.
items.cn: 政治与科学用法使它成为泛指「无依赖」的词。

items.en: The noun for an unaffiliated member of parliament appeared in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 指无党派议员的名词用法在十九世纪出现。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the pend- hang root; the near-meaning group holds words of acting alone.
note.cn: 形近组共用表示「悬挂」的 pend- 词根；近义组收表示独立行事的词。

entries.definition: The state of being free of control.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「独立」，是本词的名词形式。

entries.definition: Needing someone or something else.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「依赖的」，去掉 in- 即成。

entries.definition: A hanging ornament.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「吊坠」，同根。

entries.definition: Not joined to others.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「分开的、单独的」。

entries.definition: Working for oneself rather than an employer.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「自雇的」。

entries.definition: Not supporting either side.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「中立的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the cut rope, the variant endings and the scientific sense of independence.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借剪断的绳子、词尾变化与科学里的独立。

normal.en: Depend plus in-, and the hanging rope is cut; nothing above holds you any more.
normal.cn: depend 加 in-，挂绳被剪断，上面再没有东西提着你。

normal.en: Independent of is the scientific spelling of no connection between two variables.
normal.cn: independent of 是科学里「两个变量无关联」的说法。

normal.en: The adjective ends in -ent, the noun in -ence: one letter keeps the family together.
normal.cn: 形容词以 -ent 结尾，名词以 -ence 结尾，一个字母维系着这家人。

normal.en: An independent voter stands between two columns, touching neither.
normal.cn: 独立选民站在两根柱子之间，谁也不扶。

normal.en: Independent films are made without a big studio hanging over the director.
normal.cn: 独立电影是在没有大制片厂压着导演的情况下拍出来的。

abstract.en: Independence is a relation described by its absence: freedom from someone, not freedom in general.
abstract.cn: 独立是一个由「缺席」描述的关系：相对于某人的自由，而非笼统的自由。

abstract.en: To be independent is to carry one's own weight, which is also to feel it.
abstract.cn: 独立就是自己承担重量，也就要感到那份重量。

abstract.en: Science charges a high price for independence: nothing may be taken on trust.
abstract.cn: 科学为独立付出高昂代价：任何事都不许只凭信任接受。

examples.en: The children grew more independent as they got older.
examples.cn: 孩子们长大后越来越独立。

examples.en: Her decision was independent of mine.
examples.cn: 她的决定与我无关。

examples.en: He works as an independent consultant.
examples.cn: 他做独立顾问。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地盆登特」——自己印地、自己有盆，抬头登上高处，不靠别人。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ depend （de- + pendere「悬挂」）→ independent；同根词有 depend、dependence、suspend、pendant。

sensesIntro.en: Independent denies hanging from another, and the denial stretches from a person to a country, to a variable, to an organization and finally to a person without a party.
sensesIntro.cn: independent 否定「挂在别处」，这一否定从人扩展到国家、变量、机构，最后落成没有党籍的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two pillars standing without any beam between them.
core.cn: 核心意象：两根柱子各自立着，中间没有横梁。

branches.en: PERSON LINE: decisions are made without help.
branches.cn: 个人线：决定无需他人帮助。

branches.en: STATE LINE: a territory governs itself.
branches.cn: 国家线：领土自行治理。

branches.en: SCIENCE LINE: no variable moves another.
branches.cn: 科学线：没有变量牵动另一个。

branches.en: INSTITUTION LINE: no party or company owns the work.
branches.cn: 机构线：作品不属于党派或公司。

branches.en: POLITICS LINE: a label becomes a person.
branches.cn: 政治线：一个标签变成了一类人。

intro.en: A negative prefix on a compound of down and hang, plus an adjective ending.
intro.cn: 一个否定前缀加在「向下 + 悬挂」的合成词上，再接形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin pendere, to hang, with de-, down, and the negative in-, gave independentem.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 pendere「悬挂」加 de-「向下」，再加否定 in-，构成 independentem。

definition_zh: 独立地；自主地；互不相关地
definition_en: in a way that does not rely on or affect others
core_image: 两条平行小路各走各的，从不交叉
scene: 老师让大家各自想办法，不许商量。The two teams worked independently on the same problem.
sceneCN: 这里 independently 是「各自独立地」（第 1 个义项：不受他人影响地进行）；句意是两个小组各自独立研究同一个问题。

pos.zh: 副词：独立地；自主地；互不相关地

collocations.phrase: arrive independently at the same answer
collocations.zh: 各自独立得出同一答案

forms.label: 无变化（副词无词形变化）

derivatives.zh: 义为「独立的」，是本词的形容词基础
义为「独立、自主」
义为「依赖地」，去掉 in- 即成相反形式

senses.title: Working without help
senses.titleCN: 独立地：不依靠他人工作
senses.definition: doing something without help or direction from other people
senses.definitionCN: 在没有他人帮助或指导的情况下做事
senses.example: The two teams worked independently on the same problem.
senses.exampleCN: 两个小组各自独立研究同一个问题。
senses.why: The -ly adverb simply turns the cut rope of independent into a way of acting.
senses.whyCN: -ly 副词把 independent 那根剪断的绳子变成一种行动方式。

senses.title: Without being affected by
senses.titleCN: 不受影响地：与……无关
senses.definition: in a way that is not influenced by or connected with something else
senses.definitionCN: 以不受他物影响、与之无关的方式进行
senses.example: Prices moved independently of demand.
senses.exampleCN: 价格与需求的变动无关。
senses.why: The phrase independently of marks the missing link between two variables.
senses.whyCN: independently of 这个搭配标出两个变量之间缺失的那条连线。

senses.title: Separately, each on its own
senses.titleCN: 分别地：各自单独立进行
senses.definition: used when two or more people do the same thing separately
senses.definitionCN: 用于两个以上的人分别做同一件事
senses.example: Two labs independently confirmed the result.
senses.exampleCN: 两个实验室各自独立确认了这个结果。
senses.why: Science trusts a finding more when separate routes reach the same place.
senses.whyCN: 当不同路径到达同一处，科学就更信任这个发现。

senses.title: Politically self-governing
senses.titleCN: 自主地：在治理上自立
senses.definition: in a manner of self-government, without outside control
senses.definitionCN: 以自行治理、不受外部控制的方式
senses.example: The region is governed independently.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区自行治理。
senses.why: The political sense of the adjective passes unchanged into the adverb.
senses.whyCN: 形容词的政治含义原封不动地传给了副词。

intro.en: Independently is independent with the adverb ending -ly, ultimately from Latin in-, not, and pendere, to hang.
intro.cn: independently 是 independent 加副词词尾 -ly 构成，最终源自拉丁语 in-（不）与 pendere（悬挂）。

items.en: Pendere meant to hang, and dependere meant to hang from.
items.cn: pendere 意为「悬挂」，dependere 意为「悬于」。

items.en: The adjective independent was formed with the negative in-.
items.cn: 形容词 independent 由否定前缀 in- 构成。

items.en: Adding -ly produced the adverb for the manner of acting alone.
items.cn: 加 -ly 后产生了表示「独自行动方式」的副词。

items.en: Scientific writing adopted independently of for unconnected variables.
items.cn: 科学写作采用 independently of 来表示彼此无关的变量。

items.en: Its use in politics and journalism follows the adjective.
items.cn: 它在政治与新闻中的用法则跟随形容词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the independent stem; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of doing things apart.
note.cn: 形近组共用 independent 词干；近义组收表示「分开进行」的副词。

entries.definition: Free from control by others.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「独立的」，是本词基础。

entries.definition: The state of being free of control.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「独立」。

entries.definition: In a way that relies on another.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「依赖地」。

entries.definition: One by one, not together.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「分别地、分开地」。

entries.definition: Without other people present.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「独自」。

entries.definition: Without help.
entries.definitionCN: 副词或形容词，义为「无外力帮助地」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the parallel path image, the independently of phrase and the double-check practice in science.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借平行小路、independently of 搭配以及科学里的双重验证。

normal.en: Independent plus -ly: the adverb tells how the work is done, not what the thing is.
normal.cn: independent 加 -ly：副词说明事情怎么做，而不说明事物是什么。

normal.en: Independently of is two words that erase a link; drop of and you still describe a person.
normal.cn: independently of 是两个抹掉连线的词；去掉 of，仍在描写一个人。

normal.en: Two labs, one answer: the adverb is the whole method of science in a word.
normal.cn: 两个实验室、一个答案：这个副词就是一个词的科学方法。

normal.en: Dependently exists too, though we rarely praise it; the in- carries the praise.
normal.cn: dependently 也存在，只是很少被称许，是 in- 带来了褒义。

normal.en: Parallel lines never meet, which is exactly what prices and demand were said not to do.
normal.cn: 平行线永不相交，这正是「价格与需求无关」的说法。

abstract.en: Working independently is not working alone; the difference is whether help was refused or simply absent.
abstract.cn: 独立工作不等于独自工作，差别在于帮助是被拒绝还是本就不在。

abstract.en: Independence becomes meaningful only when someone else's path exists to be compared with.
abstract.cn: 只有存在可比较的另一条路，独立才有意义。

abstract.en: An adverb cannot change the world, only the manner in which we meet it.
abstract.cn: 副词不能改变世界，只能改变我们面对世界的方式。

examples.en: She learned to study independently at university.
examples.cn: 她在大学里学会了独立学习。

examples.en: The two events happened independently of each other.
examples.cn: 这两件事彼此无关地发生了。

examples.en: Judges must decide independently of public opinion.
examples.cn: 法官必须不受舆论左右地作出判断。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地盆登特立」——自己占地有盆，还独自立着，便是独立地。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ pendere（悬挂）→ independent + -ly → independently。

sensesIntro.en: Independently converts freedom from hanging into a manner of acting, so it covers working unaided, being unaffected, acting separately and self-government.
sensesIntro.cn: independently 把「不悬挂」变成行动方式，因此涵盖独自工作、不受影响、各自进行与自治。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: two parallel paths that never cross.
core.cn: 核心意象：两条永不相交的平行小路。

branches.en: WORK LINE: the task is done without help.
branches.cn: 工作线：任务在无人帮助下完成。

branches.en: LINK LINE: no influence crosses between two things.
branches.cn: 关联线：两事物之间没有影响通过。

branches.en: METHOD LINE: two routes check one result.
branches.cn: 方法线：两条路径检验一个结果。

branches.en: POLITICS LINE: a region rules itself.
branches.cn: 政治线：地区自行治理。

branches.en: VALUE LINE: independence is praised when it also respects others.
branches.cn: 价值观线：能同时尊重他人的独立才被称许。

intro.en: A negative prefix, a root for hanging, an adjective ending and an adverb ending stacked together.
intro.cn: 否定前缀、表示「悬挂」的词根、形容词词尾与副词词尾依次叠加。

latinIntro.en: Latin in-, not, plus pendere, to hang, plus -entem and -ly gave independently.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in-「不」加 pendere「悬挂」，再加 -entem 与 -ly，构成 independently。

definition_en: an alphabetical list at the end of a book, or a number that shows a level or change
core_image: 一根食指，指着书后的字母表，告诉你从哪一页找起
scene: 查资料时，先翻书末的索引比一页页读快得多。Look it up in the index at the back of the book.
sceneCN: 这里 index 是「索引」（第 1 个义项：书末按字母排列的条目表）；句意是到书后的索引里查一下。

pos.zh: 名词：索引；指数；指标；食指
动词：为……编索引；把……列为指标

derivatives.zh: 义为「指数化」，指工资等按指数调整
义为「与指数挂钩的、附有索引的」
义为「编索引的人」

senses.title: A list pointing to pages
senses.titleCN: 索引：指向页码的目录
senses.definition: an alphabetical list of names or subjects with the pages where they appear
senses.definitionCN: 按字母排列的名称或主题表，并注明出现页码
senses.example: Look it up in the index at the back of the book.
senses.exampleCN: 到书后的索引里查一下。
senses.why: Latin index meant the finger that points, and a list of pointers is the same gesture in print.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 index 意为「指点的食指」，而一串指路的条目正是同一手势印在纸上。

senses.title: A number showing a level
senses.titleCN: 指数：显示水平的数字
senses.definition: a number that measures changes in prices, wages or production compared with a base
senses.definitionCN: 与基期相比，衡量价格、工资或产量变化的数字
senses.example: The price index rose again last month.
senses.exampleCN: 上个月物价指数又上涨了。
senses.why: A single number points to the state of a larger system, so economics borrowed the pointer.
senses.whyCN: 一个数字指向更大系统的状况，经济学于是借用了这根指头。

senses.title: A sign of something else
senses.titleCN: 指标：另一事物的标志
senses.definition: something that shows the level or condition of another thing
senses.definitionCN: 能显示另一事物水平或状况的东西
senses.example: Handwriting is a poor index of character.
senses.exampleCN: 笔迹不是反映性格的好指标。
senses.why: Any sign can point the way the finger does, so the word widens to evidence.
senses.whyCN: 任何迹象都能像食指那样指点方向，于是词义扩展到「证据」。

senses.title: The finger that points
senses.titleCN: 食指：用来指点的指头
senses.definition: the finger next to the thumb, used for pointing
senses.definitionCN: 拇指旁用来指点的指头
senses.example: He cut his index finger on a page.
senses.exampleCN: 他的食指被书页划破了。
senses.why: The oldest sense survives in the fixed phrase index finger, a trace of the word's birth.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项保存在 index finger 这个固定搭配里，留下词诞生的痕迹。

senses.title: To make an index, as a verb
senses.titleCN: 编索引：动词用法
senses.definition: to prepare an index for a book or to record items in one
senses.definitionCN: 为书编索引，或把条目录入索引
senses.example: The archive has indexed every letter.
senses.exampleCN: 档案馆已为每封信编了索引。
senses.why: Once the noun exists, the verb simply says what one does with it.
senses.whyCN: 名词一旦存在，动词只需说明拿它做什么。

intro.en: Index is Latin for a pointer or forefinger, from indicare, to point out.
intro.cn: index 是拉丁语中「指点者、食指」一词，源自 indicare「指出」。

items.en: Index meant the finger that points and also a sign or informer.
items.cn: index 指指点的食指，也指标志或告发者。

items.en: A title in a book was called an index because it pointed to chapters.
items.cn: 书的标题被称为 index，因为它指向各章。

items.en: Printing gave index the modern sense of an alphabetical list of pages.
items.cn: 印刷术赋予 index 现代含义：按字母排列的页码表。

items.en: Politics borrowed it for the Index of banned books.
items.cn: 政治借它指代「禁书目录」（Index）。

items.en: Statistics gave it the sense of a measuring number.
items.cn: 统计学又给了它「衡量数字」的含义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the indic- root; the near-meaning group holds words for lists and measures.
note.cn: 形近组共用 indic- 词根；近义组收表示目录与度量的词。

entries.definition: To show or point out something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「表明、指示」，同根。

entries.definition: The classical plural of index.
entries.definitionCN: index 的拉丁式复数。

entries.definition: To start a line further from the margin.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「缩进」，与 index 形近。

entries.definition: The list of chapters at the front of a book.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目录」，在书前。

entries.definition: A sign that shows a level or change.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指标、指示物」。

entries.definition: An ordered list of items for reference.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「目录、编目」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the pointing finger, the split plural and the stock market index.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借指点的食指、双重复数与股市指数。

normal.en: The index finger and the book index are the same word: both point where to look.
normal.cn: index finger 与书里的索引是同一个词：两者都指向该看的地方。

normal.en: Two plurals exist: indexes for lists and indices in science, as Latin once had it.
normal.cn: 它有两个复数：目录用 indexes，科学用 indices，沿用拉丁旧形。

normal.en: The Shanghai Composite is an index because one number points at hundreds of shares.
normal.cn: 上证指数之所以叫 index，是因为一个数字指向成百上千只股票。

normal.en: Contents tells you what chapters there are; index tells you where a word hides.
normal.cn: contents 告诉你有哪些章，index 告诉你某个词藏在哪。

normal.en: A poor index of character: a sign points at something without being that thing.
normal.cn: a poor index of character：标志指向某物，却并不等于该物。

abstract.en: To index is to decide in advance which words will be findable later.
abstract.cn: 编索引就是预先决定日后哪些词能被找到。

abstract.en: An index is a map of a book, and every map lies about something.
abstract.cn: 索引是一本书的地图，而每张地图都在某处有所隐瞒。

abstract.en: A single number that stands for a whole system always hides the disagreements inside it.
abstract.cn: 用一个数字代表整个系统，必然隐藏了其中的分歧。

examples.en: The report includes an index of names.
examples.cn: 报告附有一份人名索引。

examples.en: The consumer price index fell slightly.
examples.cn: 消费物价指数略有下降。

examples.en: She pointed with her index finger at the map.
examples.cn: 她用食指点着地图。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印得克斯」——印刷时把条目印得整齐，还得配上索引。

root: 拉丁语 index（指点者、食指），源自 indicare（指出，由 in- + dic-「说」构成）；同根词有 indicate、dictate、dictionary、contradict。

sensesIntro.en: Index starts as a pointing finger, turns into a printed list of pointers, then into a number that points at a system, then into any sign at all, and finally into the act of making such a list.
sensesIntro.cn: index 起于指点的食指，转为纸上的指路表，再转为指向系统的数字，继而泛指任何标志，最后成为「编索引」这个动作。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a forefinger pointing at a lettered list behind the book.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根食指指着书后按字母排列的表。

branches.en: BOOK LINE: a list points to pages.
branches.cn: 书本线：一份表指向各页。

branches.en: NUMBER LINE: one figure points at an economy.
branches.cn: 数字线：一个数字指向整个经济。

branches.en: EVIDENCE LINE: any sign can point at a condition.
branches.cn: 证据线：任何迹象都能指向某种状况。

branches.en: BODY LINE: the pointing finger keeps the oldest sense.
branches.cn: 身体线：指点的食指保留着最古老的义项。

branches.en: ACTION LINE: to index is to build the pointing list.
branches.cn: 动作线：编索引就是造出那张指路的表。

intro.en: A Latin root for pointing and saying, with a noun ending meaning one who does.
intro.cn: 一个意为「指出、说出」的拉丁词根，加一个表示「做某事者」的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin indicare, to point out, with -ex, produced index, one who points.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 indicare「指出」加 -ex，构成 index「指点者」。

items.example: the root of dictate and dictionary
items.exampleCN: dictate 与 dictionary 的词根

items.meaning: to say aloud for another to write

definition_en: to show that something exists or is likely, or to point it out
core_image: 手指在图纸上轻轻一点，示意某项出了问题
scene: 仪表盘上亮起红灯，说明发动机可能过热。The gauge indicates a sudden rise in temperature.
sceneCN: 这里 indicate 是「显示」（第 1 个义项：表明某种情况存在）；句意是仪表显示温度突然升高。

pos.zh: 动词：表明；显示；指出；暗示

derivatives.zh: 义为「迹象、指示」，由本词加 -ion 构成
义为「指标、指示器」
义为「表明的、暗示的」，常与 of 连用
义为「索引、指标」，与本词同根

senses.title: To show as a sign
senses.titleCN: 表明：作为某种情况的标志
senses.definition: to show that a state or event exists
senses.definitionCN: 显示出某种状况或事件存在
senses.example: The gauge indicates a sudden rise in temperature.
senses.exampleCN: 仪表显示温度突然升高。
senses.why: The Latin dicare means to make known, and in- points the gesture at something specific.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dicare 意为「使之知晓」，in- 则把这个动作指向具体对象。

senses.title: To point out directly
senses.titleCN: 指出：直接指明
senses.definition: to show a thing to someone by pointing or naming it
senses.definitionCN: 通过指点或说出名称来把某物显示给人
senses.example: He indicated the seat beside him.
senses.exampleCN: 他指了指身边的座位。
senses.why: The oldest sense is physical: a finger makes the message known without words.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项是具体的：一根手指不动嘴就把信息告知了。

senses.title: To suggest without saying
senses.titleCN: 暗示：不直说而表露
senses.definition: to make a wish or opinion known indirectly
senses.definitionCN: 间接地表露愿望或看法
senses.example: She indicated that she would rather stay.
senses.exampleCN: 她暗示自己宁可留下。
senses.why: A point can be polite as well as clear: the finger moves, the sentence remains unsaid.
senses.whyCN: 一指既可清晰也可含蓄：手指动了，话却没说出口。

senses.title: To be a sign of, of data
senses.titleCN: 表明：数据与研究中的用法
senses.definition: used of facts or studies to show what they suggest
senses.definitionCN: 用于事实或研究，表示其暗示的结论
senses.example: The results indicate that the method works.
senses.exampleCN: 结果表明这个方法有效。
senses.why: Research cannot speak, so the verb lets numbers point at a conclusion.
senses.whyCN: 研究本身不会说话，这个动词让数字指向一个结论。

senses.title: To signal on a vehicle
senses.titleCN: 打转向灯：车辆上的指示
senses.definition: to signal an intention to turn, using lights on a car
senses.definitionCN: 用汽车灯示意即将转向
senses.example: Always indicate before you turn.
senses.exampleCN: 转弯前一定要打转向灯。
senses.why: A machine repeats the gesture for you, so the word replaces the verb signal in British usage.
senses.whyCN: 机器代替人做这个手势，于是英式英语用这个词代替 signal。

intro.en: Indicate comes from Latin indicare, to point out, from in- and dicare, to make known.
intro.cn: indicate 来自拉丁语 indicare「指出」，由 in- 与 dicare「使之知晓」构成。

items.en: Dicare meant to proclaim or dedicate, from the same family as dicere, to say.
items.cn: dicare 意为宣告或奉献，与 dicere「说」同族。

items.en: Indicare meant to point out or show, often with a gesture.
items.cn: indicare 意为指出或显示，常伴手势。

items.en: English borrowed it to describe signs and measurements.
items.cn: 英语借它描述标志与测量结果。

items.en: The verb became a standard word in reports of data.
items.cn: 这个词成为报告数据时的标准用词。

items.en: British English made it the everyday word for signalling in a car.
items.cn: 英式英语让它成为汽车打转向灯的日常说法。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the indic- root; the near-meaning group holds verbs of showing.
note.cn: 形近组共用 indic- 词根；近义组收表示「显示」的动词。

entries.definition: A sign that something exists.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「迹象、指示」。

entries.definition: A gauge or sign that shows a level.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指示器、指标」。

entries.definition: To give time or effort to a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「奉献」，与 indicate 形近。

entries.definition: To make something visible or clear.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「显示」，最通用。

entries.definition: To make someone think something is likely.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「暗示、表明」，语气更弱。

entries.definition: To make known something hidden.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「揭示」，强调原本隐藏。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the pointing gesture, the dictionary root and the turn signal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借指点的手势、dictionary 词根与转向灯。

normal.en: Dictionary and dictate share the root to say; indicate is the root plus in, saying towards a thing.
normal.cn: dictionary 与 dictate 共有「说」的词根；indicate 就是该词根加 in，朝着某物说话。

normal.en: Indicate that is the standard opening of any scientific finding.
normal.cn: indicate that 是一切科学结论的标准开头。

normal.en: Indicate the seat: a finger does the work of a whole sentence.
normal.cn: indicate the seat：一根手指干完了一整句话的活。

normal.en: In British cars, indicate is written on the turn signal lever's job description.
normal.cn: 在英国车里，转向灯杆的职责就用 indicate 来写。

normal.en: Indication, indicator, indicative: the ending changes but the pointing stays.
normal.cn: indication、indicator、indicative：词尾在变，指点的动作不变。

abstract.en: To indicate is to stay one step short of proof, and careful writers keep that step.
abstract.cn: 表明离证明还差一步，谨慎的写作者会守住这一步。

abstract.en: A sign is always smaller than the thing it points to.
abstract.cn: 标志永远比它所指向的东西小。

abstract.en: Language indicates before it states, and most arguments turn on that gap.
abstract.cn: 语言先暗示再陈述，多数争论就出在这道缝隙上。

examples.en: The map indicates where the river bends.
examples.cn: 地图标出了河流拐弯的地方。

examples.en: Early studies indicated a strong link.
examples.cn: 早期研究显示出很强的关联。

examples.en: He indicated with a nod that he agreed.
examples.cn: 他点头表示同意。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地开的」——地图印得清楚，标示该走的方向。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）+ dicare（使之知晓，源自 dicere「说」）→ indicare（指出）；同根词有 index、indication、dedicate、dictate、dictionary。

sensesIntro.en: Indicate begins as a finger making a thing known, then covers any sign, indirect hints, research findings and finally a car's signal lamp.
sensesIntro.cn: indicate 起于手指把某物点明，随后涵盖任何标志、间接暗示、研究结论，最后还指汽车上的信号灯。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a finger tapping a blueprint to show where the fault lies.
core.cn: 核心意象：手指在图纸上轻点，示出故障所在。

branches.en: SIGN LINE: readings and results point at a condition.
branches.cn: 标志线：读数与结果指向某种状况。

branches.en: GESTURE LINE: a hand shows the object itself.
branches.cn: 手势线：手直接示出对象。

branches.en: POLITENESS LINE: a wish is expressed without words.
branches.cn: 委婉线：愿望不必说出口。

branches.en: DATA LINE: numbers point at a conclusion.
branches.cn: 数据线：数字指向一个结论。

branches.en: MACHINE LINE: a lamp repeats the gesture for the driver.
branches.cn: 机器线：一盏灯替司机重复这个手势。

intro.en: A Latin prefix for pointing at, a root for making known, and a verb ending.
intro.cn: 一个表示「指向」的拉丁前缀、一个意为「使之知晓」的词根，以及一个动词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin in-, upon, plus dicare, to make known, plus -are gave indicare.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in-「朝向」加 dicare「使之知晓」加 -are，构成 indicare。

items.meaning: the act or sign of pointing

definition_en: a sign that shows something exists or is likely to happen
core_image: 树枝上刚冒出的那一点绿，说明春天要来了
scene: 医生看完化验单，说暂时没有恶化的迹象。There is no indication that the price will fall.
sceneCN: 这里 indication 是「迹象」（第 1 个义项：显示某事的标志）；句意是没有迹象表明价格会下跌。

pos.zh: 名词：迹象；指示；暗示

derivatives.zh: 义为「表明、显示」，是本词的动词来源
义为「指标、指示器」，同根名词
义为「表明的」

senses.title: A sign that something is so
senses.titleCN: 迹象：某情况存在的标志
senses.definition: a fact that shows something exists or is likely
senses.definitionCN: 显示某事存在或可能发生的事实
senses.example: There is no indication that the price will fall.
senses.exampleCN: 没有迹象表明价格会下跌。
senses.why: The noun turns the pointing act into the thing pointed at, so the finger becomes the trace it leaves.
senses.whyCN: 名词把「指」的动作转为「被指着的东西」，手指变成了它留下的痕迹。

senses.title: A signal given to someone
senses.titleCN: 指示：给人发出的信号
senses.definition: a signal or piece of information given on purpose
senses.definitionCN: 有意发出的信号或信息
senses.example: He gave a slight indication with his hand.
senses.exampleCN: 他用手轻轻示意了一下。
senses.why: A deliberate point is meant to be read, so the noun also names the signal itself.
senses.whyCN: 刻意的指点就是给人读的，于是名词也指那个信号本身。

senses.title: A hint about future action
senses.titleCN: 暗示：对未来打算的透露
senses.definition: a hint that something will be done, often without a promise
senses.definitionCN: 对即将做某事的暗示，通常不作承诺
senses.example: There were indications of an early election.
senses.exampleCN: 有一些提前大选的暗示。
senses.why: Politics works by hints, and the word keeps the door open because a sign is not a promise.
senses.whyCN: 政治靠暗示运转，而这个词留有余地，因为迹象不等于承诺。

senses.title: In medicine, a symptom pointing to treatment
senses.titleCN: 适应症：医学上指指向治疗的症状
senses.definition: a condition for which a particular medicine or treatment is suitable
senses.definitionCN: 某种药物或治疗适用的状况
senses.example: The drug has few indications in children.
senses.exampleCN: 这种药在儿童身上可用的适应症很少。
senses.why: A symptom points at a remedy, and doctors borrowed the same pointing word.
senses.whyCN: 症状指向一种疗法，医生借用了同样这枚「指」字。

intro.en: Indication is the noun from Latin indicare, to point out, formed with the suffix -ation.
intro.cn: indication 是拉丁语 indicare「指出」加 -ation 词尾构成的名词。

items.en: Indicatio named the act of showing or the price named in a sale.
items.cn: indicatio 指显示的动作，也指买卖中报出的价格。

items.en: English used it for signs that reveal a hidden state.
items.cn: 英语用它表示揭示隐藏状况的标志。

items.en: Medical writing adopted it for the conditions a drug treats.
items.cn: 医学写作采用它指药物可治疗的状况。

items.en: In news writing it became a cautious word for possible events.
items.cn: 新闻写作中它成为对可能事件的谨慎措辞。

items.en: The phrase indication of is now commoner than any single strong claim.
items.cn: 如今 indication of 这种说法比任何强断言都常见。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the indic- root; the near-meaning group holds words for signs and hints.
note.cn: 形近组共用 indic- 词根；近义组收表示迹象与暗示的词。

entries.definition: To show or point out something.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「表明」，是本词的动词形式。

entries.definition: A gauge or measure that shows a level.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「指标、指示器」。

entries.definition: Hard work given to a purpose.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「奉献、专心」，与 indication 形近。

entries.definition: Something that shows something else exists.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「迹象、标志」。

entries.definition: A small indirect suggestion.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「暗示」，更轻微。

entries.definition: A piece of information that helps solve a problem.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「线索」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the first green bud, the noun suffix and the cautious phrasing of news.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借第一点新绿、名词词尾与新闻里的谨慎措辞。

normal.en: Indicate plus -ion: the act of pointing becomes a thing that was pointed at.
normal.cn: indicate 加 -ion：指的动作变成了被指出的东西。

normal.en: The bud on a bare branch is an indication of spring, not spring itself.
normal.cn: 光秃枝头的芽是春天的迹象，而不是春天本身。

normal.en: There is no indication that is the politest way to say nothing has happened yet.
normal.cn: there is no indication that 是「暂时什么也没发生」最客气的说法。

normal.en: A hint is an indication given on purpose; a clue is one you happen to find.
normal.cn: hint 是有意给出的暗示，clue 是偶然找到的线索。

normal.en: Prescription labels list indications: the conditions the drug is meant to treat.
normal.cn: 处方说明上列着适应症，即这药要治的状况。

abstract.en: An indication is a bridge built halfway, enough to cross if someone else builds the rest.
abstract.cn: 迹象是一座修了一半的桥，别人补完剩下的一段才能过。

abstract.en: Signs do not lie, but readers of signs often do.
abstract.cn: 迹象不说谎，读迹象的人却常常说谎。

abstract.en: To ask for indications is to admit that certainty has not arrived.
abstract.cn: 要求给出迹象，等于承认确定性还没到。

examples.en: The results give a clear indication of progress.
examples.cn: 结果明确显示了进展的迹象。

examples.en: There was every indication that he would win.
examples.cn: 种种迹象都表明他会赢。

examples.en: Her silence was an indication of disagreement.
examples.cn: 她的沉默是不同意的表示。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地开的省」——书上印着开列的事项，那是迹象与提示。

root: 拉丁语 in-（朝向）+ dicare（使之知晓）+ -ation（名词词尾）→ indicatio（指示）；同根词有 indicate、predict、contradict。

sensesIntro.en: Indication turns the act of pointing into the evidence left behind, then into a signal, a hint and finally a medical condition that points at a remedy.
sensesIntro.cn: indication 把「指」的动作变成留下的证据，再变成信号、暗示，最后成为指向疗法的医学适应症。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the first green bud on a bare branch.
core.cn: 核心意象：光秃枝头冒出的第一点绿。

branches.en: EVIDENCE LINE: a fact points at a hidden state.
branches.cn: 证据线：事实指向隐藏的状况。

branches.en: SIGNAL LINE: a gesture is meant to be read.
branches.cn: 信号线：手势本来就是给人读的。

branches.en: POLITICS LINE: hints leave the future open.
branches.cn: 政治线：暗示让未来留有余地。

branches.en: MEDICINE LINE: a symptom points at a remedy.
branches.cn: 医学线：症状指向一种疗法。

branches.en: RHETORIC LINE: it reports without promising.
branches.cn: 修辞线：它只报告，不作承诺。

intro.en: A prefix for pointing at, a root for making known, and a noun ending for an action.
intro.cn: 一个表示「指向」的前缀、一个意为「使之知晓」的词根，以及表示动作的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin indicare, to point out, with -ationem, gave indicatio, a showing.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 indicare「指出」加 -ationem，构成 indicatio「显示」。

items.meaning: having the nature of a sign

definition_zh: 漠不关心的；冷淡的；平庸的
definition_en: not interested in or caring about something, or not especially good
core_image: 一个人坐在雨里看报，衣服湿透了也不抬头
scene: 投票那天，最怕听到的一句话是「都一样」。Most young people are indifferent to local elections.
sceneCN: 这里 indifferent 是「漠不关心」（第 1 个义项：不感兴趣、不在意）；句意是多数年轻人对地方选举漠不关心。

pos.zh: 形容词：漠不关心的；冷淡的；平庸的

derivatives.zh: 义为「冷漠、漠然」，由本词加 -ence 构成
义为「冷淡地；平平地」
义为「不同的」，与本词同根
义为「不同、相异」

senses.title: Not caring about something
senses.titleCN: 漠不关心：对该在意的事不在意
senses.definition: having no interest in or sympathy for something
senses.definitionCN: 对某事没有兴趣或同情
senses.example: Most young people are indifferent to local elections.
senses.exampleCN: 多数年轻人对地方选举漠不关心。
senses.why: The Latin word means making no difference, and a person who feels no difference does not care.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在拉丁语里意为「不造成差别」，而感觉不出差别的人自然就不关心。

senses.title: Unmoved by praise or blame
senses.titleCN: 无动于衷：不为褒贬所动
senses.definition: not influenced or excited by something that moves others
senses.definitionCN: 不被能打动他人的事物所影响或激起
senses.example: He seemed indifferent to fame.
senses.exampleCN: 他似乎对名声无动于衷。
senses.why: Stoic calm and coldness share the same shape, so the word can praise or blame.
senses.whyCN: 淡泊与冷淡形状相同，因此这个词既可用于褒也可用于贬。

senses.title: Neither good nor bad
senses.titleCN: 平平：不好也不坏
senses.definition: of only average quality, nothing special
senses.definitionCN: 质量只属一般，没有特别之处
senses.example: The food was indifferent but cheap.
senses.exampleCN: 饭菜平平，但便宜。
senses.why: If something makes no difference to you, it is neither impressive nor bad.
senses.whyCN: 如果某物对你造不成差别，它就既不出色也不糟糕。

senses.title: In science, having no effect
senses.titleCN: 无影响的：科学中不产生作用
senses.definition: in older scientific use, producing no effect or not varying
senses.definitionCN: 在旧式科学用语中，指不产生效果或不变化
senses.example: An indifferent gas does not react with the mixture.
senses.exampleCN: 惰性气体不与混合物反应。
senses.why: A substance that makes no difference to a reaction earns the same word as a careless person.
senses.whyCN: 对反应不起作用的物质与人所得的评价，竟是同一个词。

intro.en: Indifferent is in-, not, plus different, from Latin differre, to carry apart, to differ.
intro.cn: indifferent 是 in-（不）加 different，后者源自拉丁语 differre「分开携带、相异」。

items.en: Differre meant to carry apart and, by extension, to differ.
items.cn: differre 意为分开携带，引申为「相异」。

items.en: Indifferens meant making no difference between things, neither this nor that.
items.cn: indifferens 意为「不作区分」，既非此也非彼。

items.en: English first used it for undecided or neutral matters such as taste.
items.cn: 英语最初用它形容口味之类无关紧要、无可无不可的事。

items.en: The word shifted from neutral to not caring, a colder judgement.
items.cn: 词义从「中性」滑向「不关心」，评价变得更冷。

items.en: It kept the older sense of ordinary quality in phrases such as indifferent food.
items.cn: 在 indifferent food 这类说法里，它保留了「质量一般」的旧义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the differ- root; the near-meaning group holds words for coldness of feeling.
note.cn: 形近组共用 differ- 词根；近义组收表示感情冷淡的词。

entries.definition: Not the same as another.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不同的」，去掉 in- 即成。

entries.definition: A lack of interest or concern.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「冷漠、漠然」。

entries.definition: In a cold or mediocre way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「冷淡地；平平地」。

entries.definition: Not worried or interested.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「不关心的、不在意的」。

entries.definition: Showing no friendly feeling.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「冷淡的」，更口语。

entries.definition: Separate and not emotionally involved.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「超然的、抽离的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the no-difference reading, the neutral-to-cold shift and the mediocre meal.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借「无差别」的字面义、由中性转冷淡的漂移与那顿平庸的饭。

normal.en: In plus different: if nothing is different to you, you do not care which one happens.
normal.cn: in 加 different：什么对你都一样，你就不在意发生哪一个。

normal.en: Being indifferent is not the same as being different; one word means the difference has vanished.
normal.cn: indifferent 不是 different：前者说的是差别消失了。

normal.en: Indifferent food is neither good nor bad, because it makes no difference to your evening.
normal.cn: indifferent food 不好也不坏，因为它对你的这个晚上毫无影响。

normal.en: The noun is indifference, the letter e replaces the final t, like different and difference.
normal.cn: 名词是 indifference，结尾 t 换成 e，正如 different 与 difference。

normal.en: A man reading in the rain is the picture: the world is wet, he is not moved.
normal.cn: 雨里看报的人就是这幅画面：世界湿透了，他毫不动容。

abstract.en: Indifference is freedom from concern, which is either wisdom or irresponsibility.
abstract.cn: 漠然是从牵挂中脱身，它要么是智慧，要么是不负责任。

abstract.en: The opposite of love is not hate but not caring which way things go.
abstract.cn: 爱的反面不是恨，而是不在意事情往哪儿走。

abstract.en: To say something makes no difference is already a decision about it.
abstract.cn: 说某事无关紧要，本身就已经是有关它的一个决定。

examples.en: She was indifferent to the praise and kept working.
examples.cn: 她对赞扬毫不在意，继续工作。

examples.en: The service at the hotel was indifferent.
examples.cn: 那家旅馆的服务很一般。

examples.en: No one can remain indifferent to such suffering.
examples.cn: 面对这样的苦难，没有人能无动于衷。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地分润」——分红时分给谁他都一样，事不关己，便漠不关心。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ differre（分开携带、相异）→ indifferens（不作区分）；同根词有 different、differ、difference、ferry。

sensesIntro.en: Indifferent starts as a statement that no difference is made, turns into not caring, and slides from there into both coldness of feeling and ordinary quality.
sensesIntro.cn: indifferent 起初只是说「不造成差别」，随后变为「不关心」，再由此滑向感情冷淡与质量平平。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: someone reading a newspaper in the rain, never looking up.
core.cn: 核心意象：有人在雨里看报，从不抬头。

branches.en: APATHY LINE: the outcome no longer matters to someone.
branches.cn: 冷漠线：结果对某人不再重要。

branches.en: STOIC LINE: praise and blame move nobody.
branches.cn: 淡泊线：褒与贬都打不动人。

branches.en: QUALITY LINE: what moves no one is merely average.
branches.cn: 质量线：打不动人的东西也只是平常。

branches.en: CHEMISTRY LINE: a substance that changes nothing.
branches.cn: 化学线：不改变任何东西的物质。

branches.en: JUDGEMENT LINE: the same word praises calm and blames carelessness.
branches.cn: 评判线：同一个词既赞沉静也责疏忽。

intro.en: A negative prefix on a verb meaning to differ, with a participial adjective ending.
intro.cn: 否定前缀加在表示「相异」的动词上，再接分词形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin in-, not, plus differre, to carry apart, plus -ens gave indifferens.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in-「不」加 differre「分开携带」加 -ens，构成 indifferens。

items.example: the root of transfer and refer
items.exampleCN: transfer 与 refer 的词根

definition_zh: 间接的；迂回的；不直截了当的
definition_en: not going straight from one point to another, or not stated openly
core_image: 一条绕过小山的路，虽远却通向同一座村庄
scene: 想问别人的年龄，直接问不太礼貌，只好绕着说。The flight is indirect and takes two days.
sceneCN: 这里 indirect 是「不直飞的」（第 1 个义项：路线不直）；句意是这趟航班要中转，走两天。

pos.zh: 形容词：间接的；迂回的；不直截了当的

derivatives.zh: 义为「间接地」，由本词加 -ly 构成
义为「直接的」，去掉 in- 即成肯定形式
义为「方向」，与本词同根
义为「主管、导演」，同根

senses.title: Not straight in route
senses.titleCN: 迂回：路线不取直线
senses.definition: not going straight, but by a longer way
senses.definitionCN: 不取直路，而是绕更远的路
senses.example: The flight is indirect and takes two days.
senses.exampleCN: 这趟航班要中转，走两天。
senses.why: The Latin regere means to rule or guide straight, and in- removes the straightness.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 regere 意为「指引成直线」，in- 则取消了这份笔直。

senses.title: Not said or done openly
senses.titleCN: 不直说：含蓄或迂回的表达
senses.definition: not expressed in plain words, so that a listener must infer it
senses.definitionCN: 不用直白的话表达，听者须自行体会
senses.example: She made an indirect suggestion about leaving early.
senses.exampleCN: 她含蓄地提了一句早点走。
senses.why: A bend in the road becomes a bend in speech, used when plainness would be rude.
senses.whyCN: 道路的弯折变成话语的弯折，在直说会失礼时使用。

senses.title: As a secondary effect
senses.titleCN: 间接：作用经他物而致
senses.definition: happening as a result of something else rather than immediately
senses.definitionCN: 作为他事的结果而发生，而非直接产生
senses.example: The new road had indirect effects on local shops.
senses.exampleCN: 新路对本地商店产生了间接影响。
senses.why: Causes can work through a middle object, and the word marks that missing link.
senses.whyCN: 原因可以经由一个中间环节起作用，这个词就标出这条隐藏的链。

senses.title: Of light or cost, reflected
senses.titleCN: 间接的：光线或费用经反射、转嫁
senses.definition: of light, coming from a surface rather than the source; of costs, paid other than by direct charges
senses.definitionCN: 光线经表面反射而来；费用不经直接收取而是转嫁
senses.example: Soft indirect lighting makes the room feel bigger.
senses.exampleCN: 柔和的间接照明让房间显得更大。
senses.why: The same bend applies to physics and to money: the light and the cost both arrive by a detour.
senses.whyCN: 同一道弯折也适用于物理与金钱：光和钱都是绕道而来的。

senses.title: In grammar, reported speech
senses.titleCN: 间接引语：语法上的转述
senses.definition: used in grammar of speech reported without quotation marks
senses.definitionCN: 语法上指不用引号转述他人话语
senses.example: Change the sentence into indirect speech.
senses.exampleCN: 把这句话改成间接引语。
senses.why: Reported speech is one step away from the original voice, another detour.
senses.whyCN: 转述离原声已隔了一层，又是一次绕道。

intro.en: Indirect is in-, not, plus direct, from Latin dirigere, to set straight.
intro.cn: indirect 是 in-（不）加 direct，后者源自拉丁语 dirigere「使之笔直」。

items.en: Dirigere meant to set in line or to guide.
items.cn: dirigere 意为排成直线或引导。

items.en: Indirectus meant winding, not straight.
items.cn: indirectus 意为弯曲的、不直的。

items.en: English used indirect for crooked paths and for devious behaviour.
items.cn: 英语用 indirect 形容弯曲的路与不坦荡的行为。

items.en: Grammar adopted it for reported speech in the eighteenth century.
items.cn: 语法学在十八世纪用它指转述话语。

items.en: Economics and lighting added the senses of shifted cost and reflected light.
items.cn: 经济学与照明又添上转嫁费用与反射光线之义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct root; the near-meaning group holds words for winding or roundabout.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词根；近义组收表示迂回绕行的词。

entries.definition: Going straight or said plainly.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「直接的」，去掉 in- 即成。

entries.definition: In a roundabout way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「间接地」。

entries.definition: The way something goes.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「方向」，同根。

entries.definition: Long and not direct.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「绕路的、迂回的」。

entries.definition: Bending repeatedly along its length.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「蜿蜒的」。

entries.definition: Understood without being said.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「暗示的、含蓄的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the road around the hill, the plain-speaking contrast and the grammar term.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借绕山的路、与直言相对的写法以及语法术语。

normal.en: In plus direct: the line is bent, but the destination may still be reached.
normal.cn: in 加 direct：直线被折弯，终点却仍能到。

normal.en: Direct speech quotes; indirect speech reports: one small word changes the whole grammar of a story.
normal.cn: 直接引语加引号，间接引语转述：一个小前缀改了整个句子的语法。

normal.en: An indirect route is often cheaper than a direct flight, the bend has a price.
normal.cn: 迂回航线常比直飞便宜，弯折自有其代价。

normal.en: Indirect lighting means the bulb faces a wall, and the wall does the shining.
normal.cn: 间接照明是灯泡对着墙，由墙来发光。

normal.en: Being indirect in speech is not lying, only asking the listener to walk one extra step.
normal.cn: 说话迂回不是撒谎，只是让听者多走一步。

abstract.en: Every direct line is a decision to ignore the landscape.
abstract.cn: 每条直线都是一项不顾地形的决定。

abstract.en: Indirection is how fragile systems survive shocks, by travelling around them.
abstract.cn: 迂回是脆弱系统躲过冲击的方式：绕过去。

abstract.en: Not saying a thing plainly is still a way of saying it.
abstract.cn: 不把话说直白，也仍然是在说。

examples.en: They took an indirect route through the mountains.
examples.cn: 他们走了一条翻山的迂回路线。

examples.en: The cause of the illness was indirect.
examples.cn: 病因是间接的。

examples.en: He gave an indirect answer to my question.
examples.cn: 他对我的问题含糊其辞。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印地瑞克特」——印刷地图上标的路绕了一大圈，是间接的。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ dirigere（使之笔直，源自 regere「引导」）→ indirectus；同根词有 direct、direction、director、erect。

sensesIntro.en: Indirect denies a straight line, and the bent line reappears in routes, in speech, in causes, in light and money, and finally in grammar.
sensesIntro.cn: indirect 否定一条直线，而这条被折弯的线又在路线、话语、因果、光线与开销，最后在语法中复现。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a road bending around a hill yet still reaching the village.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条绕过小山的路，最终仍到村庄。

branches.en: ROUTE LINE: the journey takes a longer way.
branches.cn: 路线线：行程绕了更远的路。

branches.en: SPEECH LINE: the meaning travels around the words.
branches.cn: 话语线：意思绕开了字面。

branches.en: CAUSAL LINE: effect arrives through a middle thing.
branches.cn: 因果线：效果经由中间环节到达。

branches.en: PHYSICAL LINE: light and cost arrive from a surface.
branches.cn: 物理线：光与费用从表面传来。

branches.en: GRAMMAR LINE: the voice of another is passed on.
branches.cn: 语法线：把别人的话转述出去。

intro.en: A negative prefix on a root meaning to guide straight, with a participial adjective ending.
intro.cn: 一个否定前缀加在意为「引导成直线」的词根上，再接分词形容词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin in-, not, plus dirigere, to set straight, plus -ectus gave indirectus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in-「不」加 dirigere「使之笔直」加 -ectus，构成 indirectus。

definition_zh: 间接地；迂回地；不直接地
definition_en: in a way that is not direct or is not stated openly
core_image: 水从山上的池子顺着沟渠，绕两户人家的墙，才流进自家的菜地
scene: 有些好处不是直接拿到的，而是通过别的渠道得来。He indirectly helped me get the job.
sceneCN: 这里 indirectly 是「间接地」（第 1 个义项：不经直接方式）；句意是他间接帮我得到了那份工作。

pos.zh: 副词：间接地；迂回地；不直接地

forms.label: 无变化（副词无词形变化）

derivatives.zh: 义为「间接的」，是本词的形容词形式
义为「直接地」，去掉 in- 即成反义
义为「一……就」，与形容词 direct 同根

senses.title: Through someone or something else
senses.titleCN: 间接地：经由他人或他物
senses.definition: by means of another person or thing rather than by oneself
senses.definitionCN: 通过他人或他物，而非自己直接完成
senses.example: He indirectly helped me get the job.
senses.exampleCN: 他间接帮我得到了那份工作。
senses.why: The -ly adverb carries the detour of indirect into the manner of an action, so the action arrives by a middle step.
senses.whyCN: -ly 副词把 indirect 的绕行带进动作的方式，动作便经由中间环节到达。

senses.title: Not said in plain words
senses.titleCN: 含蓄地：不把话说白
senses.definition: in a way that suggests rather than states
senses.definitionCN: 以暗示而非直陈的方式表达
senses.example: She indirectly referred to his mistake at dinner.
senses.exampleCN: 晚饭时她间接提到了他的失误。
senses.why: Speech has its own detours, and the adverb lets a speaker step around the blunt phrase.
senses.whyCN: 话语也有自己的绕行，副词让说话人绕开那句不客气的话。

senses.title: As a secondary consequence
senses.titleCN: 间接地：作为次生的结果
senses.definition: as a result that follows through another event
senses.definitionCN: 作为经由另一事件而生的结果
senses.example: The strike indirectly raised prices across the region.
senses.exampleCN: 罢工间接抬高了整个地区的物价。
senses.why: Effects often travel through a chain, and the adverb marks the distance from cause to result.
senses.whyCN: 效果常经一条链条传递，副词标出因与果之间的距离。

senses.title: Through light or influence, not contact
senses.titleCN: 间接地：经光或影响，而非接触
senses.definition: of light or influence, reaching something through a surface or a third party
senses.definitionCN: 指光或影响经表面或第三方到达某处
senses.example: The room is lit indirectly by a lamp turned to the wall.
senses.exampleCN: 房间由一盏对着墙的灯间接照明。
senses.why: Physics and social life share the same image: something arrives without touching.
senses.whyCN: 物理与社会生活共用同一意象：某物未直接接触却已抵达。

intro.en: Indirectly is indirect plus the adverb ending -ly, built in English on Latin materials.
intro.cn: indirectly 是 indirect 加副词词尾 -ly，在英语中用拉丁材料构词。

items.en: Dirigere, to set straight, lay behind directus.
items.cn: dirigere「使之笔直」是 directus 的来源。

items.en: Indirectus named what is not straight.
items.cn: indirectus 用来命名不直的东西。

items.en: English borrowed indirect and soon added -ly for manner.
items.cn: 英语借入 indirect，很快又加 -ly 表方式。

items.en: The adverb spread into science, law and careful reports.
items.cn: 这个副词扩散到科学、法律与谨慎的报道中。

items.en: Modern prose uses it to hedge about responsibility.
items.cn: 现代文章用它来对责任作出保留。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the direct family; the near-meaning group holds adverbs of roundabout manner.
note.cn: 形近组共用 direct 词族；近义组收表示迂回方式的副词。

entries.definition: Not going straight or not said plainly.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「间接的」，是本词的基础。

entries.definition: In a straight way, or at once.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「直接地、立刻」。

entries.definition: Going straight or said plainly.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「直接的」。

entries.definition: In an indirect or evasive way.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「含沙射影地、间接地」。

entries.definition: In a way that is suggested but not stated.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「含蓄地、暗示地」。

entries.definition: By way of another person rather than directly.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「经他人转手地」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the ditch that carries water around two walls and the hedged sentence in a report.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借绕两道墙的水渠，以及报道里留有余地的话。

normal.en: Indirect plus -ly: the bend in the road becomes the bend in the way you do something.
normal.cn: indirect 加 -ly：路上的弯，变成了做事方式上的弯。

normal.en: If someone helps you indirectly, you may never learn what the favour cost them.
normal.cn: 别人间接帮你，你可能永远不知道这份人情花了对方什么。

normal.en: Reports use it to save a face: the mistake is mentioned, but no name is said.
normal.cn: 报道用它为面子留余地：错误提到了，名字没提。

normal.en: An indirectly lit room has no shadow of the lamp you can point to.
normal.cn: 间接照明的房间里，你指不出灯的影子。

normal.en: Directly moves in a line; indirectly moves along the line of the land.
normal.cn: directly 走直线，indirectly 顺着地形的线走。

abstract.en: Most of what shapes a life arrives indirectly, through chance and other people.
abstract.cn: 塑造一生的东西多半间接而来，经由偶然与他人。

abstract.en: To act indirectly is to trust that the middle steps will not break.
abstract.cn: 间接地做事，等于相信中间环节不会断。

abstract.en: The adverb hides the agent, and hiding the agent is how responsibility is thinned.
abstract.cn: 这个副词藏起施动者，而藏起施动者正是稀释责任的方法。

examples.en: Many jobs are created indirectly by small firms.
examples.cn: 许多岗位是由小公司间接创造出来的。

examples.en: She indirectly blamed the weather for the delay.
examples.cn: 她间接地把延误归咎于天气。

examples.en: The plants benefit indirectly from the shade of the trees.
examples.cn: 这些植物从树荫中间接受益。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「印的瑞克特利」——印刷单上写的路径又绕又弯，只能间接地到。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ dirigere（使之笔直）+ -ly（副词词尾）；同根词 direct、directly、direction。

sensesIntro.en: Indirectly turns the bent line of indirect into a manner: whatever happens arrives through someone, through speech, through a chain of events or through a surface.
sensesIntro.cn: indirectly 把 indirect 的弯线变成方式：发生的事都要经由他人、话语、事件链条或某个表面才能到达。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ditch carrying water around two walls to reach a garden.
core.cn: 核心意象：一条绕过两道墙、把水送进菜地的水渠。

branches.en: AGENT LINE: something is done by a middle person.
branches.cn: 施动线：某事由中间人完成。

branches.en: SPEECH LINE: the meaning comes around the words.
branches.cn: 话语线：意思绕过字面而来。

branches.en: CHAIN LINE: the result follows another event.
branches.cn: 链条线：结果跟在另一事件之后。

branches.en: SURFACE LINE: light or influence comes off a wall.
branches.cn: 表面线：光与影响从墙上反射而来。

branches.en: RESPONSIBILITY LINE: the adverb softens blame.
branches.cn: 责任线：副词让责难变轻。

intro.en: A negative prefix, a straight-line root and an adverb ending travelling together.
intro.cn: 否定前缀、直线词根与副词词尾一起出行。

latinIntro.en: Latin in- plus dirigere gave indirectus; English added -ly.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in- 加 dirigere 得 indirectus，英语再加 -ly。

definition_zh: 必不可少的；不可或缺的
definition_en: so important that it cannot be done without
core_image: 一栋房子没了承重的那根柱，整片屋顶都会塌下来
scene: 收拾行李时，总有几样东西放不下也带不走。A good dictionary is indispensable for a translator.
sceneCN: 这里 indispensable 是「不可或缺的」（第 1 个义项：少了就不行）；句意是译者的好词典是少不了的。

pos.zh: 形容词：必不可少的；不可或缺的

collocations.phrase: an indispensable member of the team
collocations.zh: 团队中不可缺少的一员

derivatives.zh: 义为「可省去的」，去掉 in- 即成反义
义为「分发、配药」，是本词的动词根
义为「必不可少地」

senses.title: Cannot be done without
senses.titleCN: 不可少：少了就无法完成
senses.definition: too necessary to be given up or left out
senses.definitionCN: 太必要，以致不能舍弃或省略
senses.example: A good dictionary is indispensable for a translator.
senses.exampleCN: 对译者来说，一部好词典是少不了的。
senses.why: Latin dispensare means to weigh out and distribute, and in- with -able says this cannot be excused from the count.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dispensare 意为「称量分发」，in- 加 -able 表示这种东西不能从账上免掉。

senses.title: Of a person, no substitute available
senses.titleCN: 无可替代：指某人无可取代
senses.definition: describing a person whose role nobody else can fill
senses.definitionCN: 形容某人的角色无人能替
senses.example: She is indispensable to the small clinic.
senses.exampleCN: 对这家小诊所来说，她是不可或缺的。
senses.why: A role, like a supply, can run out: without this person the work stops.
senses.whyCN: 角色也像物资，会断供：没有这个人，工作就停。

senses.title: Of an object, part of routine life
senses.titleCN: 日用必需：已成生活惯例
senses.definition: of a thing, so woven into daily habit that its absence is felt at once
senses.definitionCN: 指某物已融入日常习惯，一缺立刻被察觉
senses.example: The phone has become indispensable in daily life.
senses.exampleCN: 手机在日常生活中已变得不可或缺。
senses.why: Habit makes things necessary even when nothing forces us to keep them.
senses.whyCN: 习惯让东西变得必要，哪怕没有外力逼我们留着。

senses.title: In philosophy, absolutely necessary
senses.titleCN: 哲理用法：绝对必需之物
senses.definition: in abstract argument, something whose absence would make the whole system fail
senses.definitionCN: 在抽象论证中，指缺失会使整个体系崩塌的东西
senses.example: Trust is indispensable to any lasting agreement.
senses.exampleCN: 对任何持久的约定来说，信任都是不可或缺的。
senses.why: The word rises from goods to ideas: what cannot be dispensed with in logic is just as concrete.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从货物升到观念：逻辑上省不掉的东西，同样具体。

intro.en: Indispensable is in-, not, plus dispensable, from Latin dispensare, to weigh out and share.
intro.cn: indispensable 是 in-（不）加 dispensable，后者源自拉丁语 dispensare「称量分发」。

items.en: Pendere meant to hang, and so to weigh.
items.cn: pendere 意为「悬挂」，进而指「称重」。

items.en: Dispensare meant to weigh out and hand out shares.
items.cn: dispensare 意为称量后分发各份。

items.en: Dispensare also meant to grant exemption from a rule.
items.cn: dispensare 又指免除某项规矩。

items.en: Indispensable appeared for duties that could not be excused.
items.cn: indispensable 起初用于不能免除的义务。

items.en: The word widened to mean anything no plan can go without.
items.cn: 后来词义扩大，指任何计划都省不掉的东西。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the -pens- weighing root; the near-meaning group holds words for necessity.
note.cn: 形近组共用 -pens-「称量」词根；近义组收表示必要性的词。

entries.definition: That can be done without.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「可省去的」，与本词相反。

entries.definition: To give out or to do without.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「分发」或「免除」。

entries.definition: Money paid out.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「花费」，同根。

entries.definition: Absolutely necessary.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「必需的」，语气最重。

entries.definition: Necessary for life or success.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「至关重要的」。

entries.definition: Decisive for the outcome.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「关键的」，重在决定结果。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the load-bearing column and the account from which nothing can be excused.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借房子的承重柱，以及一笔什么也免不掉的账。

normal.en: In plus dispensable: cannot be dispensed with, cannot be struck off the list.
normal.cn: in 加 dispensable：省不掉，也划不掉。

normal.en: Imagine a table missing one leg: the missing leg was indispensable.
normal.cn: 想一张少了一条腿的桌子：缺的那条正是不可缺的。

normal.en: The -able says it can be dispensed with; the in- says no, not this one.
normal.cn: -able 说「可以省」，in- 说：这一个不行。

normal.en: A pharmacist dispenses medicine; what cannot be dispensed is indispensable.
normal.cn: 药剂师 dispense 药；不能 dispense 掉的，就是 indispensable。

normal.en: Used of people, the word is a compliment, but also a warning about workload.
normal.cn: 用在人身上，这是夸奖，也是关于工作量的警告。

abstract.en: What is indispensable is defined by a counterfactual: the plan fails without it.
abstract.cn: 「不可或缺」由反事实定义：没有它，计划就失败。

abstract.en: Necessity is often manufactured by habit rather than by nature.
abstract.cn: 必要性常由习惯制造，而非由天性规定。

abstract.en: Every system hides one part it could never replace, and that part holds it up.
abstract.cn: 每个系统都藏着一个再也换不掉的部件，而正是它把系统撑住。

examples.en: Clean water is indispensable to public health.
examples.cn: 清洁的水对公共卫生不可或缺。

examples.en: He soon made himself indispensable at the office.
examples.cn: 他很快成了办公室里离不开的人。

examples.en: Bicycles are indispensable in this flat town.
examples.cn: 在这座平坦的小城里，自行车必不可少。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「硬地斯彭瑟伯」——硬地上的那台喷雾器是干活必不可少的。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ dispensare（称量分发、免除），源出 pendere（悬挂、称重）；同根词 dispense、dispensable、expense、pendant。

sensesIntro.en: Indispensable says that one item cannot be taken off the list: it holds for tools, for people, for habits and for ideas.
sensesIntro.cn: indispensable 说的是某样东西不能从清单上划掉：工具如此，人、习惯与观念也如此。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a load-bearing column without which the roof falls.
core.cn: 核心意象：一根抽掉屋顶就塌的承重柱。

branches.en: TOOL LINE: an object the work cannot start without.
branches.cn: 工具线：没它工作就开不了。

branches.en: PERSON LINE: a role nobody else can fill.
branches.cn: 人物线：一个没人能补上的角色。

branches.en: HABIT LINE: a thing whose absence is felt at once.
branches.cn: 习惯线：一缺就立刻被察觉的东西。

branches.en: THEORY LINE: a condition the whole system rests on.
branches.cn: 理论线：整个体系所依赖的条件。

branches.en: VALUE LINE: praise for a person, warning for a team.
branches.cn: 价值线：对人人是赞美，对团队是警示。

intro.en: A negative prefix stacked on a weighing root, with an ability ending on top.
intro.cn: 否定前缀叠在「称量」词根上，最外层再接表能力的词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin in- plus dispensare plus -abilis built indispensable in French and English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in- 加 dispensare 加 -abilis，经法语进入英语，成为 indispensable。

latinEntries.meaning: that can be given out or excused

definition_zh: 个人；个体；单独的；独特的
definition_en: a single person, or belonging to one person only and not shared
core_image: 一整块面团被切开，每一小块都还完整地存在
scene: 班上四十个人，每个人都不一样。Each individual has different needs.
sceneCN: 这里 individual 是「个人、个体」（第 1 个义项：单个的人）；句意是每个人都有不同的需求。

pos.zh: 名词：个人；个体
形容词：个别的；单独的；独特的

derivatives.zh: 义为「个性、个体性」，由本词加 -ity 构成
义为「个人主义」
义为「分别地、逐个地」
义为「分开」，是本词的核心词根

senses.title: A single human being
senses.titleCN: 个人：单个的人
senses.definition: one person, thought of separately from the group
senses.definitionCN: 一个人，与群体分开来考虑
senses.example: Each individual has different needs.
senses.exampleCN: 每个人都有不同的需求。
senses.why: Latin dividere means to split, and in- denies it: an individual is a person who cannot be split further.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 dividere 意为「分割」，in- 加以否定：individual 就是无法再被分割的一个人。

senses.title: One apart from the rest
senses.titleCN: 单独的：与其余分开的一份
senses.definition: considered one by one rather than as a mass
senses.definitionCN: 逐个考虑而非作为整体
senses.example: The teacher gave individual help to weaker students.
senses.exampleCN: 老师给较弱的学生单独的帮助。
senses.why: To treat people individually is to refuse to lump them together.
senses.whyCN: 单独对待人，就是拒绝把人混成一堆。

senses.title: Belonging to one person only
senses.titleCN: 个人的：仅属于某一人
senses.definition: owned or used by one person rather than shared
senses.definitionCN: 由一人拥有或使用，而非共用
senses.example: Each student has an individual desk.
senses.exampleCN: 每个学生有一张自己的桌子。
senses.why: What is not divided among people stays whole with one owner.
senses.whyCN: 不与人分的东西，完整地留在一个人手里。

senses.title: Markedly personal in style
senses.titleCN: 独特的：风格带个人印记
senses.definition: showing the particular character of one person
senses.definitionCN: 显示出某一个人的特殊性格
senses.example: Her paintings have a very individual style.
senses.exampleCN: 她的画有非常独特的风格。
senses.why: If a thing cannot be divided from its maker, it carries the maker's mark.
senses.whyCN: 一样东西若无法与创作者分开，就带着创作者的印记。

senses.title: In biology, a single organism
senses.titleCN: 生物学：单个有机体
senses.definition: in biology, one living organism considered by itself
senses.definitionCN: 生物学上单独考虑的一个活体
senses.example: Scientists tracked the movements of each individual.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家追踪了每一个个体的活动。
senses.why: Ecology counts creatures one at a time, so it borrows the same unsplittable word.
senses.whyCN: 生态学一个个地数生物，于是也借了这个「不可再分」的词。

intro.en: Individual is Latin in-, not, plus dividere, to divide, plus -uus, so it means what cannot be divided.
intro.cn: individual 由拉丁语 in-（不）加 dividere（分割）加 -uus 构成，意为「不可再分的」。

items.en: Dividere meant to force apart or to split.
items.cn: dividere 意为强行分开、劈开。

items.en: Individuum was used for an atom or for a single thing.
items.cn: individuum 用来指原子或单一事物。

items.en: Scholars borrowed individuall for what exists as one whole.
items.cn: 学者借入 individuall，指作为整体存在的东西。

items.en: Philosophers used it for a single person or thing.
items.cn: 哲学家用它指单独的人或物。

items.en: Democratic debate made it a key word for personal rights.
items.cn: 关于民主的讨论让它成为个人权利的关键词。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the divide root; the near-meaning group holds words for single units.
note.cn: 形近组共用 divide 词根；近义组收表示单一单位的词。

entries.definition: One by one, separately.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「分别地、逐个地」。

entries.definition: To separate into parts.
entries.definitionCN: 动词，义为「分开」，本词词根。

entries.definition: The quality of being one distinct person.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「个性、个体性」。

entries.definition: A human being.
entries.definitionCN: 名词，义为「人」，最中性的说法。

entries.definition: One and no more.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「单一的」，重在数量。

entries.definition: Clearly different from others.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「与众不同的、独特的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the uncut lump of dough and the in- that forbids cutting.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子借那块没被切开的团子，以及禁止切割的 in-。

normal.en: In plus dividere: that which cannot be divided, and so one whole person.
normal.cn: in 加 dividere：切不开的东西，于是成为完整的一个「人」。

normal.en: Divide the class and you get individuals; the word is the shadow of the verb.
normal.cn: 把班级分开，得到一个个个人；这个词就是那个动词的影子。

normal.en: An individual desk is a desk you do not share.
normal.cn: individual desk 是一张你不与人共用的桌子。

normal.en: Individuality is what is left when the word is made a noun.
normal.cn: 加了 -ity，剩下的是 individuality，也就是个性。

normal.en: In biology every individual is counted separately, one at a time.
normal.cn: 在生物学里，每个个体都逐个计数。

abstract.en: A society is made of individuals, yet each one is more than a unit of the sum.
abstract.cn: 社会由个人组成，可每个个人都多于总和中的一个单位。

abstract.en: To be indivisible is not to be isolated; it is to be the smallest whole.
abstract.cn: 不可分不等于孤立，而是「最小的整体」。

abstract.en: The word reminds us that counting people is a choice, not a fact of nature.
abstract.cn: 这个词提醒我们：把人计数是一种选择，而非天然事实。

examples.en: Each individual is responsible for his own choices.
examples.cn: 每个人都要为自己的选择负责。

examples.en: The school offers individual lessons in music.
examples.cn: 学校开设一对一的音乐课。

examples.en: He writes in a highly individual way.
examples.cn: 他的写作风格极为独特。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因第维丢尔」——因为排第一的那个个体被单独留了下来。

root: 拉丁语 in-（不）+ dividere（分割）+ -uus → individuus（不可分的）；同根词 divide、division、individuality、individualism。

sensesIntro.en: Individual starts from what cannot be cut and becomes a name for one person, for one's own things, for one's own style and for one organism in a field.
sensesIntro.cn: individual 从「切不开」出发，成为一个人、一个人的东西、一个人的风格，以及田野中的一个个体。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: dough cut into pieces, each piece still whole.
core.cn: 核心意象：面团被切成块，每一块仍各自完整。

branches.en: PERSON LINE: a single human counted apart from the group.
branches.cn: 人身线：从群体中单独计数的人。

branches.en: COUNT LINE: help or attention given one at a time.
branches.cn: 计数线：逐个给出的帮助与关注。

branches.en: OWNERSHIP LINE: a thing not shared with anyone.
branches.cn: 归属线：不与任何人共用的东西。

branches.en: STYLE LINE: the maker's mark left on the work.
branches.cn: 风格线：创作者留在作品上的印记。

branches.en: BIOLOGY LINE: one organism in a population.
branches.cn: 生物线：种群中的一个个体。

intro.en: A negative prefix over a dividing root, with an adjective ending that makes it a thing.
intro.cn: 否定前缀压在「分割」词根上，再接形容词词尾把它变成一个「东西」。

latinIntro.en: Latin in- plus dividere plus -uus made individuus, then English individual.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 in- 加 dividere 加 -uus 构成 individuus，英语再变为 individual。

items.meaning: the state of being one distinct self

latinEntries.meaningCN: 一个不可再分的单一体

definition_en: located inside a building rather than outside
core_image: 雨天的操场空了，体育馆的门里挤满了人
scene: 下了一整周的雨，体育课全搬进了馆里。We played indoor games on rainy days.
sceneCN: 这里 indoor 是「室内的」（第 1 个义项：在建筑内部）；句意是下雨天我们玩室内游戏。

pos.zh: 形容词：室内的；户内的

derivatives.zh: 义为「在室内」，由本词加 -s 构成，多作状语
义为「户外的」，与本词相反
义为「门」，是本词的后半部分

senses.title: Located inside a building
senses.titleCN: 室内的：位于建筑内部
senses.definition: situated inside a building and not open to the sky
senses.definitionCN: 位于建筑物内部，不见天空
senses.example: We played indoor games on rainy days.
senses.exampleCN: 下雨天我们玩室内游戏。
senses.why: In- means within, and door names the boundary crossed, so indoor marks what lies on the inside of that boundary.
senses.whyCN: in- 意为「在内」，door 标出被跨过的那道边界，indoor 便指边界内侧的东西。

senses.title: Used only before a noun
senses.titleCN: 只作定语：用在名词之前
senses.definition: used as a modifier before a noun, never after the verb be
senses.definitionCN: 作定语修饰名词，不放在 be 动词之后
senses.example: The hotel has an indoor pool.
senses.exampleCN: 这家酒店有一个室内泳池。
senses.why: The bare form is a label on the doorpost; once the thing moves, English asks for indoors instead.
senses.whyCN: 光杆形式像门框上的标签；一旦东西动起来，英语就要求换成 indoors。

senses.title: Of weather or air, sheltered
senses.titleCN: 室内的：指空气、天气受遮蔽
senses.definition: describing the air or climate of a sheltered space, often in health talk
senses.definitionCN: 描述受遮蔽空间里的空气或气候，常用于健康话题
senses.example: Indoor air can be worse than the air in the street.
senses.exampleCN: 室内空气可能比街上更差。
senses.why: Health research measures what the walls trap, and the word names that trapped space.
senses.whyCN: 健康研究测的是墙内积聚的东西，这个词就命名那片被墙围住的空间。

senses.title: Of activity, taking place under a roof
senses.titleCN: 室内的：活动在屋顶之下进行
senses.definition: describing a sport or recreation played beneath a roof
senses.definitionCN: 指在屋顶下进行的运动或娱乐
senses.example: Basketball and badminton are indoor sports.
senses.exampleCN: 篮球和羽毛球是室内运动。
senses.why: Weather makes a game move its roof over it, and the word records that choice.
senses.whyCN: 天气逼着比赛搬进屋顶下，这个词记录的正是这一选择。

intro.en: Indoor is in plus door, meaning within the door of a house.
intro.cn: indoor 是 in 加 door，意为「在屋门之内」。

items.en: Dur and in existed separately: a door and a position inside.
items.cn: dur 与 in 各自独立：一个是门，一个是里面的位置。

items.en: The phrase within dore described staying inside a house.
items.cn: 短语 within dore 表示待在家里。

items.en: The compound in-door began to work as an adjective.
items.cn: 复合词 in-door 开始充当形容词。

items.en: The spelling settled as indoor, used before a noun.
items.cn: 拼写固定为 indoor，放在名词之前。

items.en: Modern sport, health studies and design made it common.
items.cn: 现代运动、健康研究与设计让它变得常见。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the door element; the near-meaning group holds words for sheltered spaces.
note.cn: 形近组共用 door 成分；近义组收表示有遮蔽空间的词。

entries.definition: Inside a building.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「在室内」，多作状语。

entries.definition: Located outside a building.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「户外的」，与本词相反。

entries.definition: Situated further inside.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「内部的」，共用 in 概念。

entries.definition: Of the inside of a building.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「内部的」，较正式。

entries.definition: Protected from weather.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「有遮蔽的」。

entries.definition: Surrounded by walls or fences.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「封闭的」。

normalIntro.en: The hooks use the doorway as a line and the sports hall full of rain-day games.
normalIntro.cn: 这些钩子把门口当作一条界线，并借雨中挤满人的体育馆。

normal.en: In plus door: if you are behind the door, you are indoor.
normal.cn: in 加 door：在门里面，就是室内的。

normal.en: Indoor before a noun; indoors for where you go: an indoor pool, but stay indoors.
normal.cn: indoor 放名词前，indoors 表在哪儿：an indoor pool，但说 stay indoors。

normal.en: Take away the roof and the word becomes outdoor.
normal.cn: 把屋顶掀掉，这个词就变成 outdoor。

normal.en: Rain moves the game inside, and an indoor sport is born.
normal.cn: 雨把比赛赶进屋，室内运动就此诞生。

normal.en: A door is thin, yet it divides two climates.
normal.cn: 一道门很薄，却分开了两种气候。

abstract.en: A wall is a decision about which weather to live in.
abstract.cn: 一堵墙，就是关于要在哪种天气里生活的决定。

abstract.en: Modern life moved far behind the door, and the word quietly records that move.
abstract.cn: 现代生活远远搬到了门后，这个词默默记下这一变迁。

abstract.en: Indoor air is still air, and what the walls keep out they also keep in.
abstract.cn: 室内的空气仍是一种空气：墙挡在外面，也关在里面。

examples.en: The children need more indoor activities in winter.
examples.cn: 冬天孩子们需要更多室内活动。

examples.en: There is an indoor market near the station.
examples.cn: 车站附近有一个室内市场。

examples.en: Indoor plants need less water in winter.
examples.cn: 室内植物在冬天需要的水更少。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「因朵」——因为下雨，花都搬到门里，成了室内的花。

root: in（在内）+ door（门，古英语 dur）→ 门内之物；同源表达 indoors、outdoor、doorway。

sensesIntro.en: Indoor begins at the doorway and names everything that lies inside it: rooms, air, sports and the grammar of a modifier.
sensesIntro.cn: indoor 从门口开始，命名门内的一切：房间、空气、运动，以及它作定语的语法位置。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a sports hall packed with people while rain falls outside.
core.cn: 核心意象：外面下雨，体育馆里挤满了人。

branches.en: SPACE LINE: the thing sits inside a building.
branches.cn: 空间线：东西位于建筑之内。

branches.en: GRAMMAR LINE: the word only stands before a noun.
branches.cn: 语法线：这个词只站在名词前面。

branches.en: HEALTH LINE: air trapped by walls gets measured.
branches.cn: 健康线：被墙围住的空气会被测量。

branches.en: SPORT LINE: the roof takes over from the sky.
branches.cn: 运动线：屋顶取代了天空。

branches.en: CONTRAST LINE: indoor always answers to outdoor.
branches.cn: 对照线：indoor 总与 outdoor 相对。

intro.en: A position prefix joined to a door word, producing an adjective of place.
intro.cn: 方位前缀接上「门」这个词，造出表地点的形容词。

latinIntro.en: The elements are Old English: in plus dur, the door; no Latin is needed here.
latinIntro.cn: 成分是古英语的 in 加 dur（门），此处不需拉丁语。

items.meaning: turning a place word into an adverb
